name: Oceanus
battlefieldValue: Late-game siege anchor that breaks bases through pressure, knockback, and sanctuary-grade elemental force.
famousFor: A towering trident-wielding lord body, a humanized elemental sovereign, and arena-wide teal-gold pressure.

monster.title: The Sanctuary Lord
monster.subtitle: Titanic water-vortex monarch
monster.body: A triple-hero-height elemental war body with a tarnished gold celestial helmet, hollow cyan-flame visor, immense blue-water musculature, floating gold tassets, and a lower body that becomes a roaring whirlpool instead of legs.
monster.weapon: An oversized pale-gold trident with crystallized cyan energy prongs, spinning ornamental rings, and vapor trails that behave like a lightning rod for sanctuary power.
monster.aura: Heavy aqua vapor, cyan elemental flame, pressure mist, and continuous ripple shockwaves around the base.
monster.signature: Slams and sweeps create defensive kinetic waves that make the Lord feel less like a monster and more like a moving objective.

human.title: Oceanus, The Primal Core
human.subtitle: Human-form elemental sovereign
human.body: A 235 cm god-like male figure with translucent cyan-blue skin, blinding turquoise eyes, waterfall-like living sapphire hair, sea-gold crest, huge sunburst pauldrons, golden vambraces, and a lower body shifting into churning current.
human.weapon: Trident of Primal Radiance, a 250 cm gold-iron staff with three translucent cyan crystal prongs vibrating with internal magical current.
human.aura: Absolute Sanctuary: rolling teal-and-gold mist scented like rain, ozone, and river moss, expanding into sharp geometric shockwaves.
human.signature: The human form reads as the intelligent will behind the Lord: regal, defensive, and ancient.

name: Thalassa
battlefieldValue: A psychological oceanic lord presence built around dread, glamour, and control-heavy pressure.
famousFor: Siren fins, violet-aqua vapor, a huge orb staff, and the feeling that the battlefield has become deep water.

monster.title: The Siren Lord
monster.subtitle: Abyssal diva manifestation
monster.body: A several-story monster with an indigo featureless mask, neon-cyan hollow eyes, magenta-violet-aqua vapor crest, floating gold wave pauldrons, long elegant clawed arms, and a serpentine vortex tail wrapped in purple fins.
monster.weapon: A massive sorcerer's staff with a dark-bronze coral shaft, golden crescent head, and spinning aqua-energy orb bound by living water ribbons.
monster.aura: A cold whirlpool of sea vapor, bright cyan water ribbons, magenta plasma, and suffocating deep-ocean glamour.
monster.signature: Commands space by turning elegance into fear; every movement looks like a ritual performance.

human.title: Thalassa, Sovereign Diva of the Abyssal Tides
human.subtitle: Human-form siren monarch
human.body: A 198 cm statuesque siren with midnight-indigo skin, fiery gold pupil-less eyes, aquamarine living-water hair tipped lavender-pink, sea-gold crown, orchid-purple fins, gold wave armor, and a colossal serpentine water tail.
human.weapon: Siren's Call Scepter, a 210 cm dark violet coral staff holding a floating aquamarine orb inside a spinning turquoise vortex.
human.aura: Abyssal Glamour: pale blue and smoky lavender mist with ocean brine, ozone, and the pressure of irresistible infatuation mixed with dread.
human.signature: A beautiful command-form that weaponizes attention before the first strike lands.

name: Lycanthros
battlefieldValue: The blue-side jungle engine, associated with cooldown rhythm, mana pressure, and tempo control.
famousFor: Lightning crystal wings, forehead core, storm claws, and the cleanest ozone aura in the jungle.

monster.title: The Thunder Fenrir
monster.subtitle: Lightning-infused blue buff beast
monster.body: A sleek quadrupedal fenrir with crystalline teeth, neon pink-violet eyes, cream-to-pink horns, white-lavender mane, violet hide, wing-like lightning crystals, plush static tail, and a magenta forehead gemstone.
monster.weapon: Its celestial body: storm fangs, crystalline claws, lightning wings, and a forehead orb that channels storm magic.
monster.aura: Magenta, cyan, and cosmic-purple electricity rippling down horns, wings, claws, and spine.
monster.signature: A speed monster that feels like mana given teeth.

human.title: Lycanthros, Tempest Soul of the Thunder Fenrir
human.subtitle: Human-form blue buff avatar
human.body: A 185 cm predatory young male with snowy-white to indigo-purple hair, neon-cyan pupil-less eyes, ivory horns, amethyst third-eye gem, exposed cyan elemental markings, crystal shard wing-mantles, hakama trousers, and an electric-purple wolf tail.
human.weapon: Tempest Fang Glaive, a 220 cm ivory polearm with turquoise wraps, cyan crystal crescent blade, and floating amethyst core.
human.aura: Static Tempest: pale-blue electricity and deep-purple arcs with rain-soaked earth, ozone, and kinetic heat.
human.signature: An agile alpha storm duelist built to look fast even while standing still.

name: Vulcanus
battlefieldValue: The red-side aggression engine, associated with dueling, burn pressure, and chase threat.
famousFor: Liquid fire mane, volcanic horns, magma cracks, and a body made to punish anyone who walks too close.

monster.title: The Molten Fiend
monster.subtitle: Red buff volcanic predator
monster.body: A hulking quadrupedal volcanic beast with a snarling stone skull, serrated obsidian teeth, neon yellow-orange slit eyes, swept shale horns, white-hot magma mane, rock-armored shoulders, burning crevices, and a whip-like fire tail.
monster.weapon: Its body: obsidian claws, fangs, explosive inner core, and a fused glyph collar containing the molten force.
monster.aura: Suffocating dry heat, ash, sulfur, ember trails, and molten-gold glow leaking from every fracture.
monster.signature: A chase predator whose heat makes the area around it feel hostile.

human.title: Vulcanus, Scourge of the Molten Fiend
human.subtitle: Human-form red buff avatar
human.body: A 196 cm heavily muscled male with living fire hair, neon-yellow eyes, charcoal-bronze skin split by magma cracks, volcanic horns, crimson tectonic brow crest, obsidian pauldrons, bronze talons, martial trousers, and a golden-orange lion tail of flame.
human.weapon: Molten Cleaver Glaive, a 230 cm polearm with blackened volcanic timber shaft, orange crystal crescent blade, and floating magma core.
human.aura: Scorching Ruin: pale-yellow fire, deep-orange arcs, sulfur, ash, and panic-inducing kinetic heat.
human.signature: The human form turns red buff into a martial inferno champion.

name: Genbu
battlefieldValue: Early-to-mid objective monarch that rewards coordinated pressure and punishes sloppy contests.
famousFor: A cryo-crystal shell, gold celestial binding, anchoring claws, and the calm violence of an ancient guardian.

monster.title: The Turtle
monster.subtitle: Cryo-shelled juggernaut
monster.body: A colossal hunched quadruped with emerald dragon-scale skull, hooked beak, cyan elemental eyes, bronze horn crest, gigantic aqua cryo-crystal shell, golden lattice spikes, stout clawed limbs, plated reptilian tail, and immovable back feet.
monster.weapon: Body mass, armored beak, golden claws, and shell runes channeling elemental power.
monster.aura: Cold cyan luminescence, ancient shell-rune pulses, and defensive pressure that feels impossible to displace.
monster.signature: A living fortress that makes every Turtle fight feel like a territorial ritual.

human.title: Genbu, Unyielding Bulwark of the Sunken Sanctum
human.subtitle: Human-form turtle guardian
human.body: A 215 cm heavily armored guardian with sapphire current hair, neon-cyan eyes, jade-white skin shifting into jade-green reptilian dermis, sea-gold crown, bronze dragon horns, massive golden armor, scaled arms, crystal shell mantle, and anchored sabatons.
human.weapon: Bulwark Scepter of Radiance, a 240 cm trident-staff with gold-iron alloy shaft and cyan crystal prongs.
human.aura: Absolute Bulwark: teal-gold mist, clean rain, ozone, cold river moss, and army-knocking geometric shockwaves.
human.signature: The objective becomes a personified tank: serene, immovable, and royal.

name: Vulcanus Cragborn
battlefieldValue: A dense side-camp bruiser whose design reads as raw durability and tectonic punishment.
famousFor: One magma eye, boulder fists, basalt body, and the feeling of a walking furnace.

monster.title: The Lava Golem
monster.subtitle: Obsidian crag brute
monster.body: A low-slung bipedal brute with head fused into torso, triangular shale faceplate, single neon-orange diamond eye, bedrock crown, split magma sternum, colossal boulder shoulders, mallet fists, compressed basalt legs, and flat stone stumps for feet.
monster.weapon: Boulder fists, pressurized molten core, and a hardened volcanic collar framing the upper body.
monster.aura: Orange magma light, scorched stone heat, volcanic pressure, and cracked earth under every stamp.
monster.signature: Less beast, more terrain disaster that learned to move.

human.title: Vulcanus, Molten Core of the Obsidian Crags
human.subtitle: Human-form lava golem
human.body: A 210 cm fortified golem-man with living orange-gold magma hair, neon-orange eyes, ash-gray basalt skin, rocky hood crest, V-shaped molten chest fissure, blocky stone gauntlets, basalt girdle, and heavy rocky greaves.
human.weapon: Forge-Master's Obsidian Cleaver, a 170 cm raw-cut obsidian blade with magma crystal fault lines and gold-iron hilt.
human.aura: Tectonic Pressure: pale orange light, purple scorch haze, sulfur, ash, and rings of volcanic fractures.
human.signature: The human form keeps the golem's weight but gives it blacksmith-god presence.

name: Ignis
battlefieldValue: A compact fire camp threat defined by burst heat, burrowing energy, and fast insectoid pressure.
famousFor: Crimson chitin, golden thermal sac, hydraulic mandibles, and predatory scuttling speed.

monster.title: The Fire Beetle
monster.subtitle: Crimson thermal hexapod
monster.body: A compact hexapod with crimson-maroon visor headplate, ivory mandibular pincers, neon-yellow compound slit eyes, spiked upper shell, layered burnt-purple thorax, glowing golden thermal core, piercing forelimbs, and explosive hind legs.
monster.weapon: Crushing mandibles, sharp forelimb talons, and a dorsal thermal core radiating suffocating dry heat.
monster.aura: Golden-orange heat shimmer, dry ash, hot chitin glow, and burrowing pressure.
monster.signature: A small camp monster that looks like it could tunnel through armor.

human.title: Ignis, Crimson Vanguard of the Fire Beetle
human.subtitle: Human-form beetle skirmisher
human.body: A 175 cm lean predatory male with orange-red to yellow-gold spiked hair, neon-yellow slit eyes, charcoal-maroon skin, crimson chitin helmet, glowing amber forehead core, yellow-orange carapace plates, bronze talons, and insect-deity appendages.
human.weapon: Pincer Tooth Glaive, a 210 cm polearm with crimson crystal pincer blade and yellow-gold gemstone core.
human.aura: Beetle-Kin Swiftness: pale-orange light, burgundy arcs, sulfur, ash, and kinetic heat.
human.signature: A fast vanguard version of the beetle, like a jungle camp promoted into an assassin.

name: Basilisk
battlefieldValue: A fast skirmish creep built around evasion, angled attacks, and lizard-like burst movement.
famousFor: Magenta frill, teal scales, whip tail, and explosive low-to-ground speed.

monster.title: The Horned Lizard
monster.subtitle: Frilled jungle skirmisher
monster.body: A knee-high bipedal reptile with needle-beak jaw, neon-blue eyes, flamboyant magenta-fuchsia umbrella frill, navy-teal skin, glowing sea-green spine armor, theropod arms, spring-loaded legs, expressive armored tail, and bird-like clawed feet.
monster.weapon: Sharp beak, obsidian claws, whip tail, and kinetic light trailing from frill and spine ridges.
monster.aura: Emerald and magenta motion trails with low whispering kinetic energy.
monster.signature: A little predator with the visual drama of a much bigger monster.

human.title: Basilisk, Draconic Skirmisher of the Jungle Marches
human.subtitle: Human-form horned lizard
human.body: A 178 cm athletic saurian fighter with violet-to-magenta hair, neon-cyan slit eyes, midnight-indigo and teal scaled skin, orchid-magenta frill crest, jade-green dorsal plates, bronze talons, martial hakama, and a prehensile spiked reptile tail.
human.weapon: Viper Tooth Glaive, a 210 cm polearm with orchid-magenta crystal crescent blade and floating cyan gemstone core.
human.aura: Saurian Swiftness: pale-teal light, deep-purple arcs, wet fern moss, ozone, and kinetic heat.
human.signature: The camp creep becomes a stylish reptilian duelist with frightening lateral speed.

name: Plutus
battlefieldValue: A gold-lane reward creature represented as wealth, greed, crystal resonance, and defensive shell pressure.
famousFor: Gold coin shell, asymmetrical claws, cyan crystals, and glittering economic magic.

monster.title: The Gold Crab
monster.subtitle: Coin-backed lane treasure
monster.body: A wide low-slung decapod with tan-bronze chitin, armored eye stalks, tooth-like brow horns, dark purple shell, cyan geode crystals on its back, fused gold coins, one massive boulder-like left claw, and four spiked walking legs.
monster.weapon: Two disproportionate claws, crystal-backed resonance, and a shell-bound pile of gold coins.
monster.aura: Golden sparkles, faint cyan vapor, and the magical pressure of wealth made territorial.
monster.signature: A reward objective that visually says: fight me if you want economy.

human.title: Plutus, Merchant Prince of the Gold Lane
human.subtitle: Human-form gold crab
human.body: A 152 cm compact merchant-crab prince with indigo-to-aquamarine topknot hair, neon-cyan eyes, golden-tan shell-fragmented skin, merchant cowl, purple silk tunic, huge chitin pauldron, gold coin pile on shell plates, and four arthropod legs.
human.weapon: Sovereign Crystal Stylus, a 180 cm dark-purple coral staff with aquamarine crystal claw and concentrated economic magic.
human.aura: Absolute Prosperity: pale blue, smoky lavender, freshly minted gold scent, and flashing golden coin sigils.
human.signature: A clever little noble who turns lane gold into personality.

name: Karkinos
battlefieldValue: An experience-lane reward creature framed as knowledge, timing, and ancient shallow-water magic.
famousFor: Back-mounted scroll, cyan geodes, crab scholar silhouette, and wisdom aura.

monster.title: The Exp Crab
monster.subtitle: Scroll-backed knowledge crab
monster.body: A broad anvil-sized decapod with fused shell-head, protected mouth apparatus, cyan eye stalks, tooth-like chitin brow, dark purple shell, raw cyan crystal library ridge, giant bound parchment scroll, asymmetrical claws, and spiked walking limbs.
monster.weapon: Crushing claws and an enormous arcane scroll that radiates sapphire-blue mana sparks.
monster.aura: Wisdom vapor, azure sparks, cyan geode shimmer, and ancient shallow-water magic.
monster.signature: A reward creature that looks like it stores experience physically on its back.

human.title: Karkinos, Scholar of the Emerald Shallows
human.subtitle: Human-form exp crab
human.body: A 152 cm compact scholar-crab youth with indigo-to-aquamarine topknot hair, neon-cyan eyes, tan shell-fragmented skin, scholar hood, purple tunic, huge chitin pauldron, rolled scroll on violet shell plates, crystal spikes, and four arthropod legs.
human.weapon: Sovereign Crystal Stylus, a 180 cm coral staff with aquamarine crystal claw and concentrated experience energy.
human.aura: Absolute Archivist: pale blue, smoky lavender, parchment, salt water, cold river moss, and golden geometric runes.
human.signature: A learned battlefield creature, small but ancient in vibe.

name: Lithos
battlefieldValue: A river tempo creature associated with movement, regeneration, vision routes, and gentle but valuable map control.
famousFor: Jade lotus shell, glowing cyan core, river mana particles, and surprisingly precious objective value.

monster.title: The Lithowanderer
monster.subtitle: Jade river sprite construct
monster.body: A tiny ankle-height circular gemstone construct with no humanoid limbs, a hollow jade shell, central neon-cyan fluid core as its single eye, four petal-like emerald armor plates, lime-green edges, tiny granite spurs, and a hovering base.
monster.weapon: None in the traditional sense; its shell, evasion, and exposed river-mana core are its survival tools.
monster.aura: Fresh water essence, sapphire-blue particles, turquoise vapor, and soothing kinetic river mana.
monster.signature: A non-aggressive map creature that feels like a living river pickup.

human.title: Lithos, Earthen Core of the Riverlands
human.subtitle: Human-form litho wanderer
human.body: A 115 cm stocky earth-sprite with aquamarine-to-yellow-green liquefied crystal hair, round neon-cyan eyes, jade-green mossy skin with turquoise fault lines, lotus-petal brow crown, moss vest, crystal carapace shoulders, reed girdle, slate tassets, and four stone limbs.
human.weapon: Core of Vitality, a floating 30 cm crystal orb protected by opening jade petals and filled with concentrated aquamarine life energy.
human.aura: Earthen Regeneration: pale blue and emerald fields smelling of rain, clover, and damp river stones.
human.signature: Small, kind, and valuable: the river's little battery given a face.
